PLAN: (1) Restore and lock the best valid three-column core; (2) use remaining solves only for high-value, single-column cost/recovery improvements; (3) avoid uneconomic heavy recovery. Step 2: bracket the root boil-up between the proven 2.30 and excessive 2.35, seeking extra C5 recovery while preserving the C4 blend.
Best .324: root 45-50/2.5/2.3/.5, T 45/3.5/2.5/.3, TB 45/5.5/5/.3; revenue about 500.5-500.9, cost 358.5-358.8. TB reflux 5.0 lost $14.9M revenue for $2.8M savings; 5.4 failed. T reflux 3.0 lost $28.2M revenue for $12.5M savings. Root reflux 2.2 degraded the split. Root pressure/double effect, heavy recovery, side draws, TB boil-up cuts, and broad stage cuts failed. Root boil-up 2.35 added $1.5M revenue but $3.8M cost and dropped C4 purity to 94%; try 2.32 as the final recovery bracket.
